name: Mavenir
description: Mavenir provides cloud-native signaling and IMS solutions for carriers with extensive 5G and next-gen network architecture capabilities.
strengths: Comprehensive cloud-native architecture with deep 5G integration
Strong global carrier relationships and extensive deployment experience
Advanced network slicing and orchestration capabilities
weaknesses: Higher implementation complexity and longer deployment timelines compared to Skyvera's streamlined solutions
Significant licensing costs and vendor lock-in concerns for Eastern European operators
Less agile in supporting legacy SS7/LTE interoperability scenarios

name: Ulticom
description: Ulticom specializes in signaling software and protocol testing solutions for telecom networks including SS7, Diameter, and emerging signaling protocols.
strengths: Deep expertise in SS7 and legacy signaling protocol troubleshooting
Established presence in Eastern European telecommunications markets
Strong focus on regulatory compliance and interoperability testing
weaknesses: Limited next-generation IMS and 5G signaling capabilities compared to Skyvera
Legacy product architecture with slower innovation cycles
Smaller ecosystem and partnership network for integrated carrier solutions
